cards.meaning: to sink to the lowest point, to be mired -- more forceful than a simple decline
cards.example: Lugmok na naman ang piso sa bagong record-low -- 62.25 sa dolyar.
cards.exampleMeaning: The peso has sunk to a new record low again -- 62.25 to the dollar.
cards.note: Stronger than plain 'bumagsak' (to fall/drop) -- 'lugmok' implies hitting the worst point, not just moving downward. Common in economic and literary writing, but also everyday ('lugmok sa hirap,' mired in hardship, for someone stuck in prolonged difficulty).
cards.tiesTo: Peso hits fresh record low of 62.25/USD on elevated oil prices widening the current-account concern

cards.meaning: a patch, a stopgap fix -- literally something stuck on to cover a hole
cards.example: Pantapal lang ang ginagawa ng DPWH -- wala pa itong iisang pambansang plano.
cards.exampleMeaning: DPWH is just doing patchwork -- they still don't have a single national plan.
cards.note: Literally a patch or plaster stuck over a hole; used figuratively for a temporary, incomplete fix rather than a real solution. Distinct from 'solusyon' (solution), which can be permanent -- 'pantapal' always carries the implication that a genuine fix is still needed later.
cards.tiesTo: DPWH Sec. Vince Dizon admits no unified national flood-control master plan exists -- only river-basin-by-basin patches, 14 of 18 basins still pending

cards.meaning: seems to be X on the surface, but is in fact Y -- corrects a reasonable-sounding misreading
cards.example: 看似是新的经济刺激，实则是地方政府债务成本的减负。
cards.examplePinyin: kàn sì shì xīn de jīng jì cì jī, shí zé shì dì fāng zhèng fǔ zhài wù chéng běn de jiǎn fù
cards.exampleMeaning: It seems like new economic stimulus, but it's in fact interest-cost relief for local governments.
cards.note: 书面语 (literary/journalistic register) -- the kind of phrasing you'd see in a news analysis piece or headline. The colloquial equivalent is 好像…其实…, which says the same thing but is how you'd put it to a friend, not in print. 看似…实则… carries more analytical weight -- it signals the writer is about to correct the reader's likely first impression.
cards.tiesTo: China's 4-trillion-yuan local-debt swap framed as interest-cost relief, not new economic stimulus

cards.meaning: to lighten a burden -- most often financial or administrative
cards.example: 新的债券置换政策为地方政府减负，节省了超过四千五百亿元利息。
cards.examplePinyin: xīn de zhài quàn zhì huàn zhèng cè wèi dì fāng zhèng fǔ jiǎn fù, jié shěng le chāo guò sì qiān wǔ bǎi yì yuán lì xī
cards.exampleMeaning: The new bond-swap policy lightens the burden on local governments, saving over 450 billion yuan in interest.
cards.note: 书面语/formal but standard policy-document vocabulary, not stiff -- the compressed two-character version you'd see in a bulletin's headline. Near-synonym 减轻负担 (jiǎnqīng fùdān) means the same thing spelled out in four characters -- use that when explaining the mechanism, use 减负 for the clipped, official tone.
cards.tiesTo: Liao Yuanyu confirms local-debt swap cuts local governments' average interest cost by over 2.5 percentage points
